sourceNote: Every entry is drawn from a verified record already in this repository. Statuses are the statuses the sources establish — a proposal is labelled proposed. Reviewed 2026-09-01; review again when any source record changes. Each entry also carries a class from the fixed vocabulary in classVocabulary; this is the single register the home page and /projects both read, so the two views can no longer diverge. The Guneku Business Directory is held from the register and from public surfacing pending a deliberate consent review; its source record is retained at src/data/institutions/business-directory.json.

notices.title: Scholarship Selection Examination
notices.description: The selection examination for Guneku Education & Scholarship Day 2026. 9:00 a.m. at the Guneku Fon's Palace, for registered candidates.

notices.title: Education & Scholarship Information Day held
notices.description: The public information day at the Palace, ahead of the selection examination. Target: 50 scholarships.

notices.title: Nineteen Meta Fons meet at Guneku Palace with MECUDA
notices.description: Seven resolutions passed on accountability, communication and development across Meta. HRH Dr. Fomuki honoured for medical education.

notices.title: How we communicate — and how to check a request for money
notices.description: Member accounts were compromised and used to ask others for money. How official announcements work, and what to do.

notices.title: Guneku Holiday Workshop 2026 held at the Palace
notices.description: Second edition. Mushroom production, edible maggots, organic fertiliser and cooking gas, tomato paste, and social talks.

notices.title: Rescue at the Ngong stream — and the water shortage behind it
notices.description: A child was rescued after the river overflowed. Parts of Guneku had been without water for about two months.

notices.title: Guneku Agro CIG launched
notices.description: Community-owned agricultural enterprise at Ngong Quarter. Phase 1 closed on 31 March 2026 having raised 12.5 million FCFA.

notices.title: GUDECA Europe meets at the Fon's Palace, Bonn
notices.description: Solar Electrification Phase II reviewed with €800 reported; the Guneku CIG presented; medical unit, soap production and digital empowerment proposed.

notices.title: Guneku Agro CIG registration certificate issued
notices.description: The Guneku Agro Common Initiative Group is formally registered at Guneku, Mbengwi.

upcomingEvents.detail: 9:00 a.m. · Guneku Fon's Palace · registered candidates only

upcomingEvents.detail: Saturday · United Kingdom · coordinated by Ni Sam

development.name: Guneku Agro CIG
development.description: Community-owned agricultural enterprise at Ngong Quarter. Registered 12 March 2026. Phase 1 raised 12.5M FCFA; poultry and turkeys under way. Current share price is not published pending confirmation by the Delegate.

development.name: GUNECCUL Credit Union
development.description: Community-owned credit union serving Guneku indigenes worldwide — savings, loans and solidarity fund shares across four branches.

development.name: Solar Electrification Phase II
development.description: €800 reported toward Phase II at the GUDECA Europe meeting in Bonn on 28 March 2026. No overall target is recorded in the sources.

development.name: Guneku Royal Community Library
development.body: Guneku sons and daughters, largely in the diaspora
development.description: Solar-powered library with computers, photocopier, printer and projector. Runs long and short computer training and holiday classes for pupils and students, and serves as the registration point for the scholarship programme. Sango Della was recorded as in charge of the Palace library in 2021.

development.name: Medical unit
development.description: A reference healthcare centre for Guneku, proposed at the Bonn meeting.

development.name: Digital empowerment
development.description: Satellite internet at the Palace, with adult training in content creation, digital work and online income skills.

development.name: Soap production
development.description: An income-generating initiative for the community, proposed at the Bonn meeting.

development.name: Afor Foundation Scholarship
development.description: Annual scholarship of over 1,000,000 FCFA for outstanding pupils in Mbengwi Central, hosted at the Palace. 200 pupils sat the 2025 examination.

development.name: Palace Renovation & Heritage Programme
development.body: HRH Fon Fomuki Walters Ticha IX
development.lastUpdate: Recognised by the Ministry of Arts and Culture
development.description: Restoration and cultural preservation of the Guneku Palace. Over $20,000 was reported raised at the GUDECA-US event of 2023.

development.name: GUYODECA bridge construction
development.description: Bridge construction by the Guneku youth association, alongside its football fixture and gift-giving to Guneku women over 50.

development.name: Tonmukom–Windik Road
development.description: Road access improved within Guneku village. Thirty-eight photographs are held in the media archive.

development.name: Fringyeng Hydroelectric Plant
development.body: Built by Kasi Rhex Ndeh · funded by Dr. Kasi Elvis
development.description: The community micro-hydroelectric plant known locally as the Oko plant, built by Kasi Rhex Ndeh and funded by Dr. Kasi Elvis. Destroyed by arson in September 2022. No rebuilding plan is recorded in the sources.

development.name: Open Door Hospital eye unit
development.description: The launch of a fully operational eye unit was announced in the village record. Its current operating status is not established in the sources.

development.name: Solar street lights - Phase 1
development.description: Solar street lights installed in the village through collective contribution by the European branch.

development.name: FUN electricity project
development.description: GUDECA Europe contributed toward the FUN electricity project in 2025.

development.name: Mbengeghang water project
development.description: Supported by the European branch in 2025.

development.name: Guneku StarLink project
development.description: Proposed under new projects at the Bonn gathering. Not yet begun.

development.name: MEDPHISATG medical school
development.lastUpdate: Visited by St Thierry University, August 2026
development.description: Medical school based in Guneku. The Fon was honoured for his achievements in medical education at the MEFU-MECUDA meeting of August 2026.

development.name: Village water supply
development.description: Parts of Guneku reported without water for about two months, raised after the rescue at the Ngong stream. Unresolved in the sources.

development.name: Guneku History Committee
development.description: Members asked GUDECA for an update on the History Committee. No launch date is recorded.

development.name: Palace caretaker post
development.description: A suggestion that a permanent caretaker for palace upkeep be funded from the annual development fees.

development.name: Outdoor table tennis courts
development.description: Locally built outdoor table tennis courts proposed for the village. Not yet progressed.

development.name: Guneku Medical Center
development.description: A facility with a fully equipped laboratory and a surgical theatre, documented as existing on 25 March 2026 on its own letterhead. Its relationship to the proposed reference healthcare centre is not established in the sources, and no claim either way is made here.

development.name: Wumnembug–Njinebai bridge
development.description: A boundary link between Wumnembug and the Guneku quarter of Njinebai, built by the Mbengwi Council and handed over around the April 2025 WUCUDA AGM in the presence of Mayor Ndangsa Kennedy Akam and his deputy Amadu Kadiri. A separate project from the GUYODECA bridge.

development.name: The Guneku Integrated Health Centres
development.lastUpdate: Assessed by the Palace and GUDECA
development.description: Three Integrated Health Centres serving the outlying quarters. Munam is operational and took an additional GUDECA-funded nurse in 2020; Mbengeghang operates without electricity; Fringyeng was built but is not recorded as having opened. Each status is the one the assessment recorded and should be re-checked.

development.name: F.H.E.D — Fons for Health, Education and Development
development.description: An association of Meta Fons headquartered in the Guneku Palace, founded in 2003 as Fons Against AIDS with the late Fon of Guneku as founding president, and renamed in 2021 as its mandate widened to health, education and development.

development.name: Fondom Studios (Guneku Branch)
development.body: Media partner of MEFU and MECUDA
development.description: A media and cultural production company founded by a son of Guneku, described as one of the first legally registered media companies in Momo Division. It covers events in the village and was recognised at the MEFU-MECUDA joint meeting held at the Palace.

development.name: Ifuh Itah — the Fringyeng Yam Festival
development.body: The people of Fringyeng, Upper Guneku
development.description: The yam harvest festival of Fringyeng, abandoned for years and revived in 2023. Held each December, and filmed in 2023, 2024 and 2025.
